description:
About the company
 Our client is a technology consulting company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Serve as a software engineer embedded with client teams, creating and supporting web and AI-enabled applications. Take responsibility for technical delivery from early design to live operation, and explain the work to business audiences. The position is fully on-site and includes periodic client visits.
 What you'll do
 - Build and support web applications and AI-enabled applications for large corporate clients.
 - Take full responsibility for technical projects, from early design through to live release.
 - Work independently in shifting, loosely defined client settings.
 - Walk clients through technical designs and finished work in a clear, advisory style.
 - Visit client sites roughly monthly to collaborate face to face with stakeholders.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, with 3 to 8 years being typical.
 - A track record of shipping and supporting web or AI-enabled applications.
 - Past experience guiding engineering efforts in a lead, founding or similarly high-responsibility position.
 - Self-direction when requirements are unclear.
 - Real experience working with clients or customers, including explaining technical topics to non-technical people.
 - Readiness for a fast-paced environment where deadlines may occasionally stretch into weekends.
 Bonus points
 - Prior experience as a startup co-founder or CTO.
 - A degree in computer science or engineering.
 - Early involvement at a small AI-focused software firm.
 - Regular use of AI-assisted coding tools.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 180,000 per year
 - Performance-based variable pay
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 - Flexible time off
 - Life and disability insurance
 - Tax-advantaged health and commuter accounts
 Location and work model
 - New York City, NY, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
